idle.method: Shared measure.py: CPU time delta / 60s wall; 3 phys_footprint samples after CPU window, maximum reported
idle.scope: Simulator App process only; excludes CoreSimulator, Simulator GUI, system services and inactive extensions

speed_gui.label_en: simctl launch PID acknowledgement (not interactive readiness)
speed_gui.method: simctl launch wall time through process PID acknowledgement after terminate; includes CLI overhead and warm filesystem cache; not first-frame or interactive-ready time
speed_gui.limitations: Process acknowledgement only, not first-frame/interactive readiness; host load is included in raw evidence.
